name: uploads
title: File uploads
description: Direct-to-storage uploads with progress: S3, R2, MinIO or any S3-compatible bucket via presigned URLs, private downloads, and a local-disk fallback in development.

env.name: S3_ENDPOINT
env.description: S3-compatible endpoint. Unset in development → files are stored in .site/dev/uploads
env.howTo: R2: dashboard → R2 → S3 API. AWS: https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com

env.name: S3_BUCKET
env.description: Bucket name. Keep it private: downloads use short-lived signed URLs

env.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Access key with read/write on the bucket
env.howTo: R2: Manage R2 API tokens → Object Read & Write. AWS: IAM user with s3:GetObject/PutObject/DeleteObject

postInstall: Development stores files in .site/dev/uploads. For production set the S3_* variables, then run `pnpm uploads:cors` once so browsers may upload to the bucket.
Drop <FileUploader /> anywhere in the app; files land in the upload table with the owner's id.
